chapter: New Orleans trombone style and composing
title: Early valve trombone players
summary: Russell asks about valve trombonists such as Frankie Dusen and Morris French; Joseph never heard them.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Did you ever hear any of the dance artists in the old days when they still used the valve? No, no. Like Old Man Carnish and some of those that used it when they, I guess Frankie. No, I don't know nothing about that. Ever hear Frankie Doosen play? No. Because that's before your time. Although he should have been around in the 20s, but you would have been pretty young.
Did you ever hear of Morris French, who was one of the old timers, but he's up around, I don't know whether it's Baton Rouge or farther south.
That's Albert French uncle, no? Yes. No, Bill, I never heard.
Or he's up around Laplace or someplace up there. Yeah.
